description: Document verification tools (doc_*) and fact_validate: results every SDK must share. Expected values are written by hand from the rules in docs/document-verification.md; document IDs, fact IDs and spans follow their published definitions (SHA-256 of the pages joined by form feeds; flf_ + Crockford base32 of SHA-256(subject, predicate, document_id, quote joined by U+001F); code-point offsets in that joined text). In arguments, {"$pages": name} stands for documents[name]. An expected value of null means the path is absent. canonical_json pins RFC 8785 serialization for fact packages. A case with "requires": "signing" needs Ed25519 (the cryptography package in Python) and is skipped without it.

Section 6.1 Exclusive Use. Landlord shall not lease space in the Shopping Center to another tenant for the sale of coffee, espresso and espresso-based beverages, except (a) a full-service restaurant may sell coffee with meals, and (b) any tenant may make incidental sales of bottled coffee drinks in up to 10% of its floor area.

Section 7.4 Kick-Out. If Gross Sales in the third Lease Year are less than $600,000, Tenant may terminate this Lease on 120 days' notice.
Section 8.1 Assignment. Tenant shall not assign this Lease without Landlord's consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed; Landlord shall receive 50% of any transfer profit.
Section 8.2 Right of First Refusal. Tenant shall have a right of first refusal on the adjacent Suite 105, exercisable within 10 business days of Landlord's notice.
